exposure: year of birth (pre-stewardship, during stewardship, post-stewardship)
cohort: 249 very low birth weight infants admitted to a single NICU in China between 2014 and 2016
finding: Restricting antibiotic use in VLBW infants through an antibiotic stewardship program was associated with a decreased duration of initial antibiotic course, total antibiotic usage days, and odds of adverse short-term outcomes.
